source.title: eFootball's Skill Mechanics Cracked: The Complete Guide
source.caveat: The article reproduces third-party work and says some findings are still being verified. Method: static analysis plus running the original ARM64 instructions in constructed scenarios. No full-match tests or match statistics.

validationLevels.constructed_validated: Documented and validated with batteries of constructed scenarios (not real matches)
validationLevels.code_documented: Documented from code analysis and individual constructed scenarios (not real matches)
validationLevels.partial: Local parameters documented; in-match reach or final outcome NOT established

skills.name: Shadow Hunt
skills.summary: Speed +3 and Acceleration +3 while chasing a loose ball an opponent played in behind.

all.label: Last touch: opponent short/through/long pass or throw (crosses and throw-ins count)
Ball is closer to own goal line than the player
Running toward own end at an angle below 90°

skills.possession: Nobody; last touch was an opponent pass
skills.zone: No own-half requirement; ball behind the player
skills.duration: Turns off at the next recalculation after an opponent receives, or when any condition fails. No fixed timer.

cap99.text: Full bonus up to 96 before the cap.

skills.movement: Attribute points, not a running-speed percentage.
skills.evidence: Code analysis and constructed scenarios (article section 01).
uncertainties: Some movement modes unmapped
Frame latency not measured

skills.name: Attack Trigger
skills.summary: Teammates (not the holder) get Offensive Awareness +3 while the skill holder has the ball.

all.label: The current ball holder (a teammate) has Attack Trigger
A teammate holds the ball (the holder does not benefit)

skills.possession: Teammate with the skill holds the ball
skills.duration: Ends on possession change, no valid holder, opponent possession or leaving IN_PLAY.

cap99.text: Full bonus up to 96 before the cap.

uncertainties: Exact frame the possession record clears during a pass

skills.name: Attacking Surge
skills.summary: Off the ball: Speed +3 and Acceleration +3 in the opponent's half while a teammate has the ball.
skills.possession: Teammate holds the ball (player off the ball)
skills.duration: Ends when he receives, opponent wins the ball, no holder, back to halfway/own half, or leaving IN_PLAY.

cap99.text: Full bonus up to 96 before the cap.

skills.movement: Attribute points, not a fixed speed percentage.

skills.name: Fighting Spirit
skills.summary: No attribute points. Cuts one ball-release penalty component under pressure (×0.8), changes AI run fatigue thresholds and relaxes low-header eligibility.
skills.duration: Passive, per sub-effect.

cap99.text: Not applicable (not attribute points).

skills.movement: Initial threshold = min(100, 60 + 10·captain + 15·FS + 15·special defensive condition); q = N(consumed %, threshold, min(threshold+20,100)); distance threshold = 40 − 35q + 15 (attacking) + (10 FS / 5 captain / 0). The fatigue ratio is internal, not the Stamina stat.
uncertainties: Full-match success and running gains not measured
Link between fatigue ratio and the stamina bar

skills.name: Fortress
skills.summary: Defensive Awareness, Tackling, Aggression and Defensive Engagement +6 (holder only) in the 2nd half or later while strictly ahead.

all.label: 2nd half or later (1st-half stoppage and half-time excluded)
Team strictly ahead (regulation + extra-time goals, no shootout)

skills.duration: Off when level or behind; back on when retaking the lead.

cap99.text: Full bonus up to 93 before the cap. The intermediate 105 is not the final readback.

skills.evidence: Code analysis + cap worked example (article sections 05 and 99 Cap).

skills.name: Super-sub
skills.summary: +1 to 25 core attributes when he comes on at half-time, in the 2nd half or in extra time.

all.label: Came on at half-time / 2nd half (flag 1) or in extra time (flags 2–3)

skills.timeScore: Starters and 1st-half subs do not qualify. No minute threshold.
skills.duration: For the rest of the match after a qualifying entry.
uncertainties: Practical benefit in shootouts not established (flag 4 during penalty prep)
Frame latency

skills.name: Momentum Dribbling
skills.summary: Dribbling, Tight Possession, Speed and Acceleration +6 while holding the ball at least 18 m past halfway.

all.label: He is the current ball holder
At least 18 m past halfway (full width, default pitch)

skills.timeScore: None. No sprint, speed or nearby-opponent requirement; no IN_PLAY check.
skills.duration: Lost when losing the ball or leaving the region.

cap99.text: Full bonus up to 93 before the cap.

uncertainties: Configurable pitch scaling not observed

skills.name: Aerial Fort
skills.summary: Physical Contact +4 and Jump +4 on defensive aerial receptions in his own box. No Heading bonus.

all.label: Last touch: short/long/through pass or throw (either team)
Nearest trajectory sample to the target is strictly higher than the player

any.label: Outside the box, open play: stored point inside own box
Outside the box, goal kick/corner/free kick: stored point and ball inside own box

skills.zone: Own penalty area (or stored point inside it)
skills.duration: While the aerial reception conditions hold.

cap99.text: Full bonus up to 95 before the cap.

skills.movement: Alternative path: header subtype with metadata 0 in long-pass, short-pass or shot categories. A PASS_GET height failure does not fall back to it. Headers in the opponent's box are not directly eligible.
uncertainties: Stored position point generation not fully traced

skills.name: GK Directing Defence
skills.summary: An on-pitch GK with the skill gives Defensive Awareness +2 and Tackling +2 to CB/LB/RB at −18 m or deeper.

all.label: On-pitch formation GK has the skill (subs do not count)
Recipient is CB/LB/RB (not DMF or GK)

skills.duration: Ends if the recipient leaves the zone or becomes ineligible, or the GK no longer qualifies.

cap99.text: Full bonus up to 97 before the cap.

skills.evidence: Code branch + constructed scenario, not match statistics. Datamine (libUE4.so) gives Tackling instead of the article's Aggression; the datamine value is used (user decision, 18 Oct 2026).
uncertainties: A failed separate test does not prove the code is absent

skills.name: GK Spirit Roar
skills.summary: A GK with the skill gives Physical Contact, Jump and Acceleration +2 to CB/LB/RB in the 2nd half while ahead.

all.label: Strictly ahead (a draw does not count)

skills.duration: While score and time conditions hold.

cap99.text: Full bonus up to 97 before the cap.

uncertainties: 'Physical abilities' must not be extended to Speed, Stamina or all defensive stats

skills.name: Low Screamer
skills.summary: A Stunning Shot below 50% power uses a dedicated low-shot motion and +0.2 to the local power parameter. Kicking Power is unchanged.
skills.magnitude: Local power +0.2 (e.g. 0.4→0.6); another error coefficient reads power +0.1 (not quantified)
skills.duration: Per action; no cooldown found.

cap99.text: Kicking Power 99 does not disable the motion.

skills.movement: Avoids the Dipping Shot branch. Backward or acrobatic variants not established.
uncertainties: Effect of the +0.1 coefficient not quantified (not accuracy +10%)

skills.name: Acceleration Burst
skills.summary: Hook-touch motions and motion-calculation parameters. Does not write Speed or Acceleration.
skills.magnitude: Hook angle (15.5°,120°]; internal speed limit 11→16; normalised TP coefficient +0.1; multiplier 1→1.025
skills.duration: Per motion.

cap99.text: Not attribute points.

skills.movement: +20 to an evaluation score (capped at 100); +0.2 to a distance-check window; +0.1 to an unnamed dribble-branch field.
uncertainties: Final acceleration, top speed and cooldown not quantified
Full input conditions

skills.name: Long-reach Tackle
skills.summary: Enables medium- and long-range standing reach tackles and widens orientation corrections.
skills.magnitude: +5.625° one-side orientation limit (7 animations); +3 lateral correction limit (3 of them)
skills.duration: Per action.

cap99.text: Still helps at Tackling 99: not attribute points (there is no '102').

skills.movement: At Tackling 99: limit 11.25°→16.875°; another 22.5°→28.125°; stationary lateral limit 2→5. Expansion branch needs angle ≤ 60°; two other motions need contact angle ≥ 112.5°.
uncertainties: No universal reach in metres
Success rate and cooldown not measured

skills.name: Visionary Pass
skills.summary: The receiver of his footed pass gets a local +6 to the ability used in the very next action.

all.label: Marker active: footed short/through/long pass from a Visionary Pass passer
No ordinary trap, contact dribble or contact feint before the action

skills.duration: No timer. A new contact record replaces it on release. Moving or waiting without contact does not consume it.

cap99.text: Local, applied after readback: not capped at 99 or 120.

skills.movement: Headed passes create no marker. A first adjustment touch inside the same animation (≥2 contact points) can keep it.
skills.evidence: R19 (+6 local and priority), R20 (no timer), R21–R22 (22 marker validation sets).
uncertainties: Validated with prepared records, not full motion selection
Not every feint mapped

skills.name: Bullet Header
skills.summary: Five independent effects on headed shots; no universal Heading +N.
skills.magnitude: Retention 1−0.20r²→1−0.15r²; tier-9 loss 8%→5% / 13%→10%; perturbation 0.4→0.5; max ball speed +4 km/h; contact severity ×0.5
skills.duration: Per action.

cap99.text: Coexists with ordinary Heading +5: Heading 99 → local 104.

uncertainties: Specific motion IDs not mapped
Match rates not measured

skills.name: Phenomenal Pass
skills.summary: Special motions: local +6 to Low Pass (ground) or Lofted Pass (lofted), plus error-penalty changes.

all.label: Ground or lofted pass (not header, not heel category 8)
Special motion (metadata 5–7, direction class <5 or >12, tier 2–11, or other documented predicates)

skills.duration: Per action.

cap99.text: 99 → local 105 (coef. ≈1.066667). Downstream parameters stay clamped.

skills.movement: Classes 4 and 13 (sideways ~90°): ability bonus but no backward-error change. Classes 0,2,15,17 (~135° backward): both. Forward or diagonal-forward alone: no bonus. Skips q-discounts (×0.6, ×0.8, ×0.9). Example q=1: max bound 76.169→77.417 km/h; sideways 77.634→77.984 km/h (bounds, not release speeds).
uncertainties: Motion IDs not mapped to visible animations

skills.name: Phenomenal Finishing
skills.summary: Special non-header shooting motions: local Finishing +7 plus error and posture changes.

all.label: Special motion (same predicates as Phenomenal Pass)

skills.duration: Per action.
skills.movement: Posture retention (severity 1): 0.90 at effective 99, ≈0.946667 at 106; weight 0 at 114. Acrobatic error ×0.9 (×0.8 with Acrobatic Finishing). Other backward error: acrobatic ×0.7 (×0.4 with AF); other categories ×0.2.
skills.evidence: R25; R15 (correction of earlier posture conclusions).
uncertainties: Motion IDs and match rates not measured

skills.name: Game-changing Pass
skills.summary: Low Pass +6 and Lofted Pass +6 in the 2nd half or later while level or behind.

all.label: Level or behind (regulation + extra time, no shootout)

skills.timeScore: 2nd half or later; drawing or losing
skills.duration: Off when the team takes the lead; back on when level or behind.

cap99.text: Full bonus up to 93 before the cap.

skills.name: Edged Crossing
skills.summary: Selects motion 80: a high, sharply dipping cross with its own spin and launch angle.
skills.magnitude: Launch angle +3.8° or +2.5° (clamped 0–31°); spin components 4.6/−3.6 or 3.4−N(d,25,30)/−2.4

all.label: Cross (context 4/5/6 with cross flag, command mode 19)
Ball speed before the kick below 30 km/h

skills.duration: Per action.

cap99.text: No Lofted Pass or Curl bonus (tested with 80 and 99).

skills.movement: Foot chosen from preferred foot and Weak Foot Accuracy; motion 80 needs resources.
uncertainties: Ball-speed increase NOT confirmed (12 identical sets)
Flags not fully mapped

skills.name: Blitz Curler
skills.summary: A type-10 Controlled Shot at 50%+ power selects motion 160 with a power remap and extra launch angle.
skills.duration: Per action.

cap99.text: Finishing or Curl 99 does not cancel the motion.

skills.movement: Foot checks: preferred foot, weak-foot accuracy/usage, allowed-foot mask. Same-side wide case: deviation ≤ 10°. Exclusion flag c0 must be 0.
uncertainties: Meaning of c0
Match reach and scoring not measured

skills.name: Magnetic Feet
skills.summary: Dribbling, Tight Possession, Physical Contact and Balance +2 per nearby opponent (max 4) while holding the ball.

all.label: Registered ball holder (a nearby loose ball does not count)
≥1 active opponent at horizontal distance 0 < d < 5 m, not in the 180° blind spot directly behind (datamine)

skills.duration: Recalculated from nearby opponents.
skills.movement: Speed, Acceleration and Ball Control are not affected. The angle check only excludes exactly 180°.
skills.evidence: R29: 112 activation, 9 boundary and 360 addition/readback checks (481 total). Datamine: 180° rear blind spot; base ≤ 91 for the full +8.
uncertainties: No installed-game, full-match or frame-timing test

auxiliarySkills.name: Through Passing (+5 local)
auxiliarySkills.note: Article: ordinary passing +5 (local). Datamine (libUE4.so): Through Passing is a hybrid +5 applied to random deviation, trajectory and lofted apex on through passes; the turn animation uses the base stat.

auxiliarySkills.name: Ordinary shooting skill (+5)
auxiliarySkills.note: The article mentions 'ordinary shooting +5' (Phenomenal Finishing: +7, not +12) without listing skills.

auxiliarySkills.name: Heading (+5 local)
auxiliarySkills.note: 'Ordinary Heading local +5 coexists: Heading 99 becomes local 104.'

stackingRules.text: They add up: the 4 defensive stats get +7; the other 21 get +1.
Cannot both give Speed/Acceleration (+9) in the same possession check (holder vs teammate holder).
Five different stats get +2 each (no +4 on any).
They coexist; Bullet Header adds no fixed Heading (99 → local 104 from the ordinary +5).
Local checks intersect in resources; match reachability not guaranteed.

temporaryDifferentSkills.text: Adding temporary bonuses from different skills on the same stat is only confirmed for Fortress + Super-sub. Other pairs are added as a HYPOTHESIS.

localSameSelector.text: Documented pairs take the maximum. Unlisted pairs (e.g. Visionary +6 vs Heading +5) use 'maximum' as a HYPOTHESIS.

competingErrorScores.text: Competing error scores: the maximum is taken, then a random check.
